### fallingDrop2d

This example type simulates a drop falling into a pool of the same liquid.
@fig-fallingDrop2d shows an excerpt of the first couple of time steps.
On the right half of these steps, the forming of a so-called crown can be seen.

![Setup and some exemplary steps of the example `fallingDrop2d`.](/examples/freeSurface/fallingDrop2d/doc/fig/fallingDrop2d.png){#fig-fallingDrop2d width="100%"}
